mapper.insert: insert into `task`(user_id, name, content, type, start_time, end_time, reward, status) values(#{userId}, #{name}, #{content}, #{type}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{reward}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, name, content, type, start_time, end_time, reward, status, completed_at, created_at from `task` where id = #{id}
select id, user_id, name, content, type, start_time, end_time, reward, status, completed_at, created_at from `task` where user_id = #{userId} order by status asc, end_time asc, id desc
mapper.update:
update `task`
status = #{status},
completed_at = NOW(),
where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
update `task` set status = 2 where status = 0 and end_time < NOW()
update `task` set status = 2 where status = 0 and end_time < NOW() and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from `task` where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
